plan.goal: Erase overlapping areas of PACounties from generated_polygon to produce a non-overlapping difference layer.
plan.notes: Both inputs use EPSG:4269. Perform a vector difference/erase operation where generated_polygon is the input layer and pacounties is the erase layer. Retain original id field.

plan.goal: Merge the erased polygon layer with the PACounties layer into a single unified Shapefile.
plan.notes: Combine features from both inputs into one Shapefile. Handle differing attribute schemas by preserving all columns and filling missing values with nulls. Ensure valid geometry types.
